evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 443.0 °C, sharply discordant with all other column temperatures (63.3–75.5 °C).
T701 remains exceptionally high at 446.4 °C while other temperatures are 63.3–74.3 °C; this persistent discrepancy requires independent verification, not an assumption of thermocouple drift.
System pressure is 500.0 mbar and pressure differences are 0.6 and 2.7 mbar, with no sustained pressure excursion over the observed interval.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.4 and 0.0 L/h; both have remained low or intermittent. FYI702 reads 6.8, which cannot be verified as an instantaneous flow ratio with zero distillate flow.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and signal-scaling checks, protocol phase and temperature/flow setpoints with safety limits, and FYI702 definition are needed to distinguish real overheating from measurement error and assess flow compliance. No composition measurement or separation target has been supplied. Times are elapsed from the first event.
